stories.title: More rain to affect Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Rain is expected Wednesday into Thursday across central NC.

stories.title: Triangle families look for ways to stretch Thanksgiving budgets
stories.summary: Savings experts recommend splitting meal costs, using coupons, and shopping for store brands.

stories.title: ICE smashes car window, detains man outside Santa Clarita, California Sheriff's Station | Video
stories.summary: ICE agents were seen smashing a car window and detaining a man outside a Santa Clarita, California Sheriff's Station.

stories.title: Drought reveals remnants of communities beneath Jordan Lake in North Carolina
stories.summary: History is resurfacing at a lake in NC. Prolonged drought conditions have exposed remnants of communities dating to the 1700s.

stories.title: New York City Police Department releases videos of shooting outside Bronx deli; Victor Soto arrested
stories.summary: The NYC Police Department released videos of a shooting outside a Bronx deli; Victor Soto was arrested.

stories.title: Navy keeps Black Pearl Harbor hero's name on carrier after weighing renaming it for Trump
stories.summary: Navy officials had weighed renaming the vessel for Trump, sources said.

stories.title: Trump targets Newsom in Justice Department speech over erasure of death row sentences in California
stories.summary: President Donald Trump condemned California Gov. Gavin Newsom’s clemency to the state’s death row inmates in a speech at the Justice Department on Monday.

stories.title: LA-area Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after ethics committee finds he made unwelcome sexual advances to staffer
stories.summary: The House Ethics Committee said in a report that there is “substantial evidence” that Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez of California engaged in sexual misconduct.

stories.title: Trump granted new chance to potentially erase his hush money case
stories.summary: An appeals court is giving President Trump a new chance to move his criminal hush money case into federal court, where he could then attempt to overturn his conviction.

stories.title: Much needed rain in Central North Carolina slightly slows Christmas tree sales
stories.summary: Recent rainfall brought some relief to drought conditions, but it also created challenges on Sunday for others and for businesses in the Triangle.

stories.title: Many still aren't home two years after Helene; Nearly $40M in federal money aims to speed recovery
stories.summary: Gov. Josh Stein announced nearly $40 million in federal funding aimed at helping six communities rebuild commercial districts and strengthen local economies.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel ramps up, many families are opting to drive rather than fly
stories.summary: AAA projects that nearly 73 million people will travel during the Thanksgiving holiday period.
